set.body: Whole-board review 2026-10-23 found compare.participants remains the generic empty placeholder in the Results summary layout. Actual participants are available in the plot/Table twins and participant table, so no scientific value is missing, but the dedicated navigator drawn by Results.dc.html is not implemented. Evidence: docs/studio/evidence/20261023-parity/Results/light-1x.png and review.json participants disposition. Implement a one-stop composite navigator from served overall participant cells at the selected scale, with exact StudioRef provenance, contributing/requested/failed counts, keyboard row cursor and activation into the same participant query context as Explain. Preserve grouped vs overall identity; no locally computed science. Add portable JVM/JS behaviour cases and native click/keyboard/selection/a11y cases; update the board review and tab-order evidence. This is a functional follow-up, not claimed complete by closing the visual parity review.
set.title: Results: populate the Participants navigator with served cells and keyboard navigation
